name: qBittorrent
description: qBittorrent-nox with the web UI: a self-hosted BitTorrent client you control from the browser.

configFields.label: Admin password
configFields.help: Auto-generated. The image ships with no fixed login: on first boot it either prints a random temporary password to the container log, or falls back to admin/adminadmin on older builds. This value is pre-seeded into the WebUI's config before qBittorrent starts, so you get a real password here instead.

connection.title: Sign in to qBittorrent
connection.description: Sign in with the username and generated password below. qBittorrent never had to invent its own temporary password — this one was set before the app's first start.

firstLogin.note: Account changes made in the app (a password change, new users) are preserved on redeployment. These are the initial credentials.

features.title: Browser-controlled downloads
features.description: Add, manage, and monitor torrents from a web UI, no desktop client needed.

features.title: Persistent storage
features.description: Config and downloaded files stay on project-scoped volumes across deployments.

files.content:
#!/bin/sh
set -e
configFile="/config/qBittorrent/config/qBittorrent.conf"
if [ ! -f "$configFile" ]; then
  hash=$(python3 -c "
import os, base64, hashlib, secrets
pw = os.environ['ADMIN_PASSWORD'].encode()
salt = secrets.token_bytes(16)
dk = hashlib.pbkdf2_hmac('sha512', pw, salt, 100000, dklen=64)
print('@ByteArray(' + base64.b64encode(salt).decode() + ':' + base64.b64encode(dk).decode() + ')')
")
  mkdir -p "$(dirname "$configFile")"
  cat <<CONF > "$configFile"
[BitTorrent]
Session\DefaultSavePath=/downloads
Session\Port=6881
Session\TempPath=/downloads/temp
Session\TempPathEnabled=true
[Meta]
MigrationVersion=9999
[Preferences]
WebUI\Port=8080
WebUI\Username=$ADMIN_USERNAME
WebUI\Password_PBKDF2=$hash
CONF
fi
exec /entrypoint.sh
